chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Karram, from Ibn Abi Yafur, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), that he used to say:
O Allah, fill my heart with love for You, and fear of You, and affirmation and faith in You, and awe of You, and longing for You, O Possessor of Majesty and Honor.

O Allah, make meeting You beloved to me, and make for me in Your meeting the best of mercy and blessing, and join me with the righteous, and do not delay me with the evil, and join me with the righteous of those who have passed, and make me with the righteous of those who remain, and take me by the way of the righteous, and assist me upon myself with what You assist the righteous upon themselves, and do not return me to evil after You have rescued me from it.

O Lord of the worlds, I ask You for faith that has no end until meeting You, causing me to live and die upon it, and resurrect me upon it when You resurrect me, and free my heart from show-off and fame and doubt in Your religion. O Allah, give me victory in Your religion, and strength in Your worship, and understanding in Your creation, and two portions of Your mercy, and whiten my face with Your light, and make my desire to be what is with You, and cause me to die in Your way upon Your religion and the religion of Your Messenger.

O Allah, I seek refuge in You from laziness, old age, cowardice, stinginess, heedlessness, hardness of heart, weakness, and poverty. And I seek refuge in You, O Lord, from a self that is not satisfied, and from a heart that does not humble itself, and from a supplication that is not heard, and from a prayer that is not beneficial. And I seek refuge in You for myself, my family, and my offspring from the accursed Satan.

O Allah, no one can protect me from You, and I find no shelter besides You, so do not abandon me, and do not return me to destruction, nor return me to punishment. I ask You for steadfastness upon Your religion, and affirmation of Your Book, and following of Your Messenger. O Allah, remember me with Your mercy and do not remember me with my sin, and accept from me, and increase me from Your grace, for I am longing for You.

O Allah, make the reward of my speech and the reward of my sitting Your pleasure with me, and make my deeds and my supplication sincere for You, and make my reward Paradise by Your mercy, and gather for me all that I asked You for, and increase me from Your grace, for I am longing for You.

O Allah, the stars have set, and the eyes have slept, and You are the Living, the Eternal. Neither the dark night hides from You, nor the sky with its constellations, nor the earth with its beds, nor the deep sea, nor the darknesses one upon another. You send down mercy upon whom You will of Your creation. You know the treachery of the eyes and what the chests conceal.

I testify with what You testified to Yourself, and Your angels testified, and the people of knowledge, that there is no god except You, the Mighty, the Wise. And for one who did not testify with what You testified to Yourself, and Your angels testified, and the people of knowledge, so write my testimony in place of their testimony.
O Allah, You are Peace and from You is Peace. I ask You, O Possessor of Majesty and Honor, to free my neck from the Fire.
ai.seo_question: What is the supplication for general needs narrated from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) in Al-Kafi?
ai.summary: This comprehensive supplication (Du'a) from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) serves as a holistic guide for spiritual refinement, integrating theological affirmations with practical ethical requests. It is particularly significant in Shia tradition for its emphasis on purifying the heart from hidden vices like *riya* (show-off) and *ghaflah* (heedlessness), while anchoring the believer in the concept of *Tawhid* through the declaration of witness. The structure reflects the Shia scholarly focus on aligning internal states with external actions to achieve ultimate liberation from Hellfire.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Hassan Bin Ali, from Karram, from Ibn Abu Yafour, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, that he<sup>asws</sup> used to recite (the following supplication):

‘O Allahazwj! Fill my heart with love for Youazwj, and humbleness from Youazwj, and ratification and Eman in Youazwj, and distinction from Youazwj, and desire to Youazwj, O the One with the Majesty and the Benevolence!

O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Cause me to love meeting You<sup>azwj</sup>, and Make for me, during Your<sup>azwj</sup> meeting, best of the Mercy and the Blessings, and Join me with the righteous ones and do not Delay me with the evil ones, and Join me with the righteous ones of the past and Make me to be with the righteous ones who remain, and Take me to the way of the righteous ones, and Assist me upon myself with what You<sup>azwj</sup> Assisted the righteous ones upon themselves, and do not Repel me to be in evil but You<sup>azwj</sup> would be Rescuing me from it.

O Lordazwj of the worlds! I ask Youazwj for Eman there being nor reason for it except Meeting Youazwj, Causing me to live, and Causing me to die upon it, and Resurrecting me upon it when Youazwj do Resurrect me, and free my heart from the show-off, and to be heard of, and the doubts in Yourazwj Religion. O Allahazwj! Give me victory in Yourazwj Religion, and strength to be in Yourazwj worship, and understanding in Yourazwj creation, and two portion from Yourazwj Mercy [57:28], and Whiten my face with Yourazwj Noor (Light), and Make my desire to be in what is with Youazwj, and Cause me to pass away being in Yourazwj Way, upon Yourazwj Religion, and Religion of Yourazwj Rasoolsaww.

O Allahazwj! I seek Refuge with Youazwj from the laziness, and the infirmity (of old age), and the cowardice, and the stinginess, and the neglect-fullness, and the cruelness, and the weakness, and the destitution. And I seek Refuge with Youazwj, O Lordazwj, from a self not being satiated, and from a heart not fearing, and from a supplication not being heard, and from a Salāt not being beneficial. And I seek Refuge with Youazwj for myselfasws, and myasws family, and myasws offspring, from the Pelted Satanla.

O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! It is such that no one can Rescue me from You<sup>azwj</sup>, and I cannot find anyone as a Shelter besides You<sup>azwj</sup>. Therefore, do not Abandon me, and do not Repel me to be in destruction, nor Repel me to be in a Punishment. I ask You<sup>azwj</sup> of the steadfastness upon Your<sup>azwj</sup> Religion, and the ratification of Your<sup>azwj</sup> Book, and following of Your<sup>azwj</sup> Rasool<sup>saww</sup>. O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Remember me by Your<sup>azwj</sup> Mercy, and do not Remember me with my mistakes, and Accept from me, and increase for me from Your<sup>azwj</sup> Grace, I am being hopeful to You<sup>azwj</sup>.

O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Make the Reward of my<sup>asws</sup> speaking, and the Reward for my sitting as being Your<sup>azwj</sup> Pleasure from me, and Make my deeds and my supplication to be sincerely for You<sup>azwj</sup>, and Make my Reward to be the Paradise by Your<sup>azwj</sup> Mercy, and Make to be for me the entirety of what I am asking You<sup>azwj</sup> for, and Increase it for me from Your<sup>azwj</sup> Grace, I am being hopeful to You<sup>azwj</sup>.

O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! The stars have disappeared, and the eyes are sleeping, and You<sup>azwj</sup> are the Living, the Eternal. Neither is the dark night hidden from You<sup>azwj</sup>, nor is the sky with the constellations, nor the earth with the flatness, nor the unfathomable ocean, nor the darkness on top of each other. You<sup>azwj</sup> Bestow the Mercy upon the one whom You<sup>azwj</sup> so Desire to from Your<sup>azwj</sup> creatures. You<sup>azwj</sup> Know the betrayal of the eyes and what the chests conceal.

I testify with what You<sup>azwj</sup> Testified with upon Yourself<sup>azwj</sup>, and Your<sup>azwj</sup> Angels testified with, and the ones with the knowledge, that, there is no god except You<sup>azwj</sup>, the Mighty, the Wise; and the ones who do not testify with what You<sup>azwj</sup> Testified with upon Yourself<sup>azwj</sup> and (what) Your<sup>azwj</sup> Angels testified with, and (what) the ones with the knowledge (testified with), so Write my testimony in place of their testimonies.

O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! You<sup>azwj</sup> are the (source of) the Peace and from You<sup>azwj</sup> is the Peace. I ask You<sup>azwj</sup>, O One with the Majesty and the Benevolence, that You<sup>azwj</sup> Liberate my neck from the Fire’.
en.sarwar: 24. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from al-Hassan ibn Ali from Karram from ibn abu Ya’fur from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following:
“O Lord, fill my heart with love for You, concern about You, affirmation of and belief in Your existence, fear from You and longing toward You, O Glorious, O Magnanimous.

O Lord, make me love meeting You, and such meeting to be good, mercy, and full of blessings, join me with the virtuous and do not leave me behind with the wicked ones. Join me with the virtuous of the past and those to come, lead me on the path of virtuous ones, assist me against my soul by that with which You assist the virtuous ones against their souls, do not turn me in the evil from which You want to rescue me, O Lord of the worlds.

I plead before You for a belief free of timing before meeting You, with which You will keep me living, cause me to die, and raise me up with it when You will resurrect me. Free my heart from showing off, desire for popularity, and doubt in Your religion. “O Lord, give me victory in Your religion, energy to worship, understanding of Your creatures, support me twice with Your kindness (in this life and hereafter), brighten my face with Your light, make me interested in what is with You, cause me to die in Your way and in Your religion, the religion of Your Messenger.

“O Lord, I seek protection against laziness, old age, cowardice, stinginess, carelessness, hardheartedness, weakness, and destitution. I seek protection with You, O Lord against a soul that does not become satisfied, the heart that does not become humble, the supplication that is not heard, and the prayer (formal) that does not yield any benefit. I seek protection with You for myself, my family, and my children against condemned Satan.

“O Lord, no one can protect me against Y ou, I do not find any place to hide from You, do not humiliate me and do not throw me in perdition and in torment. I plead before You to keep me to remain steadfast in Your religion, affirm Your book, and follow Y our messenger.

“O Lord, speak of me with Your mercy and do not speak of me with my sins, accept from me (my good deeds), increase for me from Your generosity; I am interested toward You. O Lord, make my reward for speaking and sitting to be Your happiness with me, make my deeds and supplication purely for You, make my reward paradise through Y our mercy, place me together with all I pleaded for before You and increase for me through Your favor; I am greatly interested toward You.

O Lord, the stars have disappeared, eyes have gone to sleep, You are living and guarding, the dark night cannot disappear from You nor the starry skies or the well-stretched earth, the choppy ocean, or the darkness upon darkness. You send mercy upon whomever You will among Your creatures; You know the secret glance of the eyes and what the hearts conceal.

I testify to what You have testified for yourself, to what Your angels have testified, and people of knowledge have testified that no one deserves to be worshipped except You, the Majestic, the Wise. Whoever does not testify to what You have testified for yourself. Your angels have testified, and people of knowledge have testified, then write my testimony in place of their testimony.
O Lord, You are the Peace, and from You is peace. I plead before You, O the Owner of glory and magnanimity to set my neck free of the fire.’”
